Solergy studied the facility's load profile and shed roof layout before sizing a 250 kW system matched to actual daytime draw.
The result was a rooftop solar system built to meaningfully offset the facility's daytime power costs.

challenge.heading: Replicating Results at a New Site.
intro: The facility's daytime equipment load meant a correctly sized system could deliver real, measurable savings.
The installation needed to be completed efficiently, without disrupting ongoing operations.

points.title: Steady Daytime Load
points.description: A consistent daytime equipment load meant a right-sized system would deliver meaningful savings.

points.title: Efficient Rooftop Use
points.description: The available shed roof needed to be used efficiently to maximise system output.

points.title: Minimal-Disruption Installation
points.description: The rollout needed to be completed without interrupting day-to-day operations.

solution.heading: 250 kW. Efficient and Effective.
intro: Solergy designed a 250 kW on-grid rooftop system sized to the facility's actual daytime power draw.
Our team handled procurement, installation, electrical integration, testing, and commissioning end to end.

points.title: Daytime Generation
points.description: Designed to offset a meaningful share of the facility's daytime electricity consumption.

points.title: Efficient Rooftop Layout
points.description: Panels were laid out to make the most of the available shed roof area.

points.title: Long-Term Performance
points.description: Components selected for reliable, long-term operation with minimal upkeep.

paragraphs: The completed system now generates approximately 3,75,000 kWh of clean electricity every year, helping Shakunt Enterprises reduce its dependence on conventional grid power at this site.
With an estimated annual saving of around ₹31.88 Lakhs, the installation is expected to recover its initial investment in approximately 4.3 years.
Over its expected 25+ year operating life, the system can continue generating clean energy and supporting the facility's sustainability targets.
